hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Transform level outcomes into scores where one maps to positive one and zero maps to negative one.

hints.title: Score Difference
hints.text: Compute total possible game score across all levels. Player one wins if their score strictly exceeds the remaining score.

hints.title: Linear Sweep
hints.text: Maintain a running score for player one across levels one through n - 1. Return the earliest index where twice the running score exceeds total score.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass after computing total points.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recalculating both players scores from scratch takes quadratic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Map values to +1/-1 and use prefix aggregation to decide the cutoff.
